Package com.composum.sling.platform.staging.impl

Class FrozenNodeWrapper

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.composum.sling.platform.staging.impl.AbstractFrozenItem<javax.jcr.Node>
      • com.composum.sling.platform.staging.impl.FrozenNodeWrapper
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    javax.jcr.Item, javax.jcr.Node
    public class FrozenNodeWrapper
extends AbstractFrozenItem<javax.jcr.Node>
implements javax.jcr.Node
    (Not quite complete) wrapper for Node that disables writing. That's neccesary since some functions rely on adaptability to Node.

    Methods that are difficult / errorprone to implement and are likely not needed throw an UnsupportedRepositoryOperationException. We'd rather throw an exception than return a wrong value. If that occurs somewhere please complain, and it'll be done.
